oracle_note: Oracle reads true poses for diagnosis only; learned/hsv inputs have no simulator segmentation.
timing_scope: Task excludes model load/warmup and scene load. initialization_s inside run_sorting measures controller setup, not model initialization. RGB-D capture contributes only to total_s. Perception/localization are cumulative measured observations; model cold load and warmup are in metadata.models.

verification_scope.scene_filtering: None: one independently generated frozen scene was evaluated by all three methods.
verification_scope.purpose: Verify a locally trained segmentation checkpoint through localization and guarded physical sorting.
verification_scope.limitations: One scene and a smoke-trained model; no generalization, segmentation-superiority, or method-ranking claim.
verification_scope.threshold_changes: None; confidence .25 and hybrid_high .8 CLI defaults retained.
verification_scope.timing_note: Shared CPU wall-clock time; task excludes scene/model load and warmup; sensor capture is included only in total time.
verification_scope.scene_selection: Functional demo chosen after initial prediction previews of seeds 241116-241118; seed241118 had all three classes. Not a pre-registered random performance sample. All three methods and all their outcomes retained.

original_command: python -m robosort evaluate --seed 241118 --count 1 --regime color --width 320 --height 240 --methods yolo_box yolo_mask hybrid --weights artifacts/yolo26-smoke-30/best.pt --output examples/verification/learned-sorting --plots
